description: Kamchatka self-drive car rental request: car from the price list, dates, pickup; human-confirmed, no payment. Sent by the person from a Vedar link. Cars and companies come from search_car_rental; name the car as in the price list. Vedar does not track car availability: a Vedar manager confirms with the rental company, payment goes to it directly. Name and phone go to the rental company. Name, phone and consent come only from the person; never invent them. The call makes a draft: give the person the link from the reply, and they press Send on the Vedar page themselves.

car.description: Car exactly as in the search_car_rental price list.

comment.description: Wishes: child seat, drop-off elsewhere, etc.

company.description: Rental company name or slug from search_car_rental; may be omitted when there is only one.

consent.description: Explicit consent to process name and phone and pass them to the rental company; ask the person and pass true, otherwise the request is not created.

date_from.description: Rental start, YYYY-MM-DD; with plan_id, omitted means the first day of the plan.

date_to.description: Rental end, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD; with plan_id, omitted means the last day of the plan.

name.description: Renter's name, required; ask the person.

notify_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL of your receiver (host name, port 443): a signed Standard Webhooks POST on changes of state, date, offered date, tour or group size; the signing key is shown once in the reply. Not for stays. No receiver — omit, never invent one.

phone.description: Contact phone, required; ask the person for their own number in international format (country code first, +7 for Russia, 10–15 digits) and never invent one.

pickup.description: Pickup place if the person named one: airport, town, address.

plan_id.description: Plan ID from make_trip_plan when the request belongs to that plan: the manager and the rental company see the whole trip; omitted dates are taken from the plan, and a mismatch with the plan is named in the reply.

test.description: true for a dry run: the same checks as a real request, nothing stored or sent; the reply has a test_ key, and get_request_status answers state test.

name: create_car_rental_request

accepted.description: Requests accepted by this call; 0 — none (reason in the text)

confirmation.description: No request yet, only a draft: give the person url; they press Send on the Vedar page

url.description: Page where the person sends the request; never open it for them

group.description: Group larger than the tour takes: sent to the operator as a query for the whole group, seats not held; if declined, other operators of that tour type see it

seats_on_date.description: Free seats on the date; null — no schedule

tour_max.description: Tour group limit; null — not recorded or unlimited

place_status.description: Main place of the tour and its status today (tour requests). It does not stop the request; the operator confirms the trip. Tell the person about a closed or red place

color.description: Colour, also when closed; null — none

level.description: Status for going out today: closed; red, yellow, green — regional-report colour (green is no safety guarantee); unknown — no colour, not «safe»

outside_sources.description: Outside regional reports (Northern Kurils): never green; «no warnings» cannot be said

reason.description: park_season — yellow: park trails closed off-season, no independent hiking; the operator confirms park approval. null — not recorded

status_updated_at.description: Computed at, ISO 8601 UTC; null — not recorded

read.description: ok — read; no_place — tour has no main place; failed — could not read (not «no warnings»)

requests.description: Requests of this call; a trip, per part. Repeating the call within a day creates no second request: a new key to the same one

notify.description: notify_url subscription: active=true — ref and signing key (shown once); false — see reason; null — no URL

signing_secret.description: Webhook signing key (whsec_…), Standard Webhooks; store it, never publish

status_key.description: Key for get_request_status; null — not issued (key write failed)

status_page.description: Request page: give it to the person, never publish

test.description: Dry run (test: true): nothing stored or sent

title: Car rental request
